tool_limitations.limitation: Rewrites only Windows.UI.Xaml -> Microsoft.UI.Xaml. It does NOT reconcile the sample's app root namespace (SDKTemplate) to the scaffold's project namespace (Personalization), leaving the agent to hand-edit namespace/x:Class/xmlns:local across every copied file.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Detect the dominant source base namespace and rewrite it to the target project's RootNamespace across all copied .cs/.xaml (namespace decls, using, x:Class, xmlns:local).

errors_encountered.error: CS0102/CS0111: type 'App' already contains a definition for 'MainWindow'/'App'/'OnLaunched' (App.xaml.cs, build after turn 29)
errors_encountered.root_cause: An in-place edit accidentally duplicated the entire App class body in App.xaml.cs (two identical partial class App blocks).
errors_encountered.fix: Turn 35 edit removed the duplicated block, leaving a single App class; next build succeeded (turn 36).

errors_encountered.error: XamlCompiler WMC0909 'Cannot resolve DataType local:Scenario' + WMC1111 + WMC1509 'No LocalAssembly parameter given during MarkupCompilePass2' (MainPage.xaml, same failed build)
errors_encountered.root_cause: Cascade from the C# compile errors above: because the project's own C# failed to compile, MarkupCompilePass2 had no local assembly, so every project-local type (x:DataType local:Scenario) reported as unresolvable. Not an actual XAML/namespace defect.
errors_encountered.fix: Fixing only the duplicate App class made the WMC errors disappear on the next build with no XAML edit.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Build failed with 6 errors: CS0102/CS0111 duplicate members + WMC0909/WMC1111/WMC1509 XAML type-resolution errors.
dev_agent_struggles.turns_or_retries: ~turns 29-36 (one failed build, diagnosis, one fix, rebuild)
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: A botched in-place edit doubled the App class; the XAML WMC errors were a misleading cascade from that C# failure.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Agent viewed App.xaml.cs (turn 34), recognized the accidental duplication (turn 35), removed the extra block, rebuilt clean (turn 36).
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Diagnostic guidance that WMC0909/WMC1509/type-not-found XAML errors are frequently secondary to C# compile errors in the same project — fix all CSxxxx errors first, then rebuild before touching XAML.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Agent had to manually change 'namespace SDKTemplate' -> 'namespace Personalization', x:Class prefix, and xmlns:local across multiple files.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: The bootstrap does not reconcile the sample's SDKTemplate root namespace to the scaffold project namespace; every UWP Windows-universal-sample ships as SDKTemplate.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Agent hand-edited each file's namespace and XAML prefixes.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Bootstrap auto-reconciling the source root namespace to the scaffold's RootNamespace across all copied .cs/.xaml.
